ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is a point on segment $AB$ with $AC>BC$. Point $M$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point $N$ is the midpoint of segment $BC$. Given $AM=8$ and $CN=3$, find the length of segment $MN$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point M is the midpoint of line segment AB, $AM=8$,\\
hence $BM=AM=8$,\\
and since point N is the midpoint of BC, $CN=3$,\\
hence $BN=CN=3$,\\
therefore $MC=BM-BN-CN=8-3-3=2$,\\
therefore $MN=MC+CN=2+3=\boxed{5}$.
